title: Description: A schematic drawing showing a railway track running horizontally. A
context:
"PART F. OBSERVATIONS AT ČOP AND ABOUT CZECH RAILROADS"
"The trucks for the new Czech RR guage were of the two axel type."
"The switching of trucks consumed 40-45 minutes for their sleeper car."
"The switching building had a pit in the middle which the car straddled."
"Inside the sleeper there were two large square traps in the cars floor, one at either end."
"The first step was for the crew to open these doors and turn a large bar, which evidently released the truck from the body of the car."
"The Czech trucks banged the first Russian trucks out of place, continuing to the second Russian trucks and banging them out of place."
"The jacks were lowered, letting the car down to the new standard guage trucks below."
"The crew then turned the bars through the floor openings locking the new trucks in place and the passengers were informed that they could board the car."
"(See sketch for USAIRA-Hathaway version of this operation.)"
